fields.rt-blog-html:
Rounding up your bill and donating the difference to a good cause? This is the successful bet of France Snackingwhich is launching its "Printemps Engagé du Snacking et de la Restauration" operation , supported in its approach by the Leaders Club and the technological expertise of the company Heoh.

These restaurant chains that are committed

From February 1 to April 30, 2020, a multitude of restaurant and bakery chains will offer their customers the possibility of rounding up their payments to the nearest euro: Bagel Corner, Bagelstein, Columbus Café, Crep'Eat, Dubble, Eat Salad, Fresh Burritos, Indépendance Burger, It Trattoria, Factory & Co, La Famille, Les Burgers de Papa, Nachos, Piadina, Planet Sushi, Road Side, Speed Burger, Boulangeries Victor & Cie Yogurt Factory, Panasia and Pizza Cosy are among the many restaurants that are committed to the idea.Join the movement! The rounding up of funds does not represent any cost for the restaurant owner, since the programming is done at the TPE level.

The supported association: Restaurants Without Borders

Created in 2007, the association Restaurants Without Borders is committed to helping schoolchildren in disadvantaged regions around the world to eat in good sanitary conditions. RSE supports the construction of canteens, kitchens and refectories, while promoting eco-responsible approaches (vegetable gardens, solar energy ovens, etc.).

The association is accompanied by two committed sponsors, Thierry Marx and Michel Boujenah. Restaurants Without Borders at a glance, it is :

  • 49 projects in 16 countries in 12 years
  • 95% of the budget allocated to humanitarian operations
  • 8 volunteers and local partners to carry out each project

If you wish to join the process, contact France Snacking at this address printempsengage@snacking.fr .. You can also make a donation directly at the same address.
